title: Agenda for the day
vertical_agenda_phase_1_contribution:
PRODUCT • Bring customer, market, backlog, and product context; frame the opportunity.
ENGINEERING • Test technical meaning and feasibility.
vertical_agenda_phase_1_result: One feasible full-stack opportunity with a visible implementation path.
vertical_agenda_phase_2_contribution:
PRODUCT • Define the feature, stories, acceptance criteria, and evidence boundary.
ENGINEERING • Understand the repository, prove the dev loop, and surface constraints.
vertical_agenda_phase_2_result: Handoff-ready Product package and Engineering-ready environment.
vertical_agenda_phase_3_contribution:
PRODUCT • Explain intent, evidence, prototype, acceptance conditions, and open questions.
ENGINEERING • Challenge ambiguity and propose a bounded implementation slice.
vertical_agenda_phase_3_result: Agreed interface, decisions, scope, and demonstrable slice.
vertical_agenda_phase_4_title: 4. PARALLEL PRODUCT LAUNCH PREP & ENGINEERING DEV
vertical_agenda_phase_4_contribution:
PRODUCT • Complete launch planning around the agreed Product artifacts.
ENGINEERING • Plan, implement, and begin testing the slice.
vertical_agenda_phase_4_result: Launch and learning plan plus a tested local change.
vertical_agenda_phase_5_contribution:
PRODUCT • Evaluate the increment, provide actionable feedback, and assess acceptance.
ENGINEERING • Convert feedback into bounded changes; repeat testing and preserve evidence.
vertical_agenda_phase_5_result: Traceable feedback, implemented changes, and joint acceptance evidence.
vertical_agenda_phase_6_contribution:
PRODUCT • Identify operating-model, adoption, and decision implications.
ENGINEERING • Identify quality, architecture, review, CI/CD, platform, and ownership implications.
vertical_agenda_phase_6_result: Company-specific next actions and a reusable learning record.
vertical_agenda_integration_message: CENTRAL INTEGRATION POINT • The afternoon handoff connects one shared opportunity—these are not independent Product and Engineering demonstrations.
